sloka: भविष्यति दृढं रामो दुःखप्रायो ऽपि सौख्यभाक् ।प्राप्स्यते च महाबाहुर्विप्रयोगं प्रियैर्ध्रुवम् ।। ७.५०.११ ॥
transliteration: bhaviṣyati dṛḍhaṁ rāmo duḥkhaprāyo 'pi saukhyabhāk ।prāpsyate ca mahābāhurviprayogaṁ priyairdhruvam ।। 7.50.11 ॥

translations.english: Rama, though predominantly sorrowful, will certainly experience happiness, and the mighty-armed one will undoubtedly face separation from his dear ones.
translations.hindi: महाबलवान्‌ भरत, लक्ष्मण और शत्रून्न उन उत्तम भेंटों की वस्तुओं को ले कर, अयोध्यापुरी में लोट कर आ गये
